text: Implemented a dedicated deterministic value-only rigid trial kernel over the frozen objective and exact unique-point registry. Complete trials lazily sample each unique point once; early rejection memoizes only points needed by evaluated patches. Trial normalization and sign-mixture loss call the same FrozenPatchObjective3 implementation as full evaluation, including fixed invalid-patch outlier cost. Acceptance lower bound covers nonnegative product/add rounding with gamma_(2n+1) and rounds downward before comparison; incomplete trials have only RejectedEarly representation and report gradientEvaluations=0. Added support-sensitive identity/+4 mm and enumerated threshold tests, repeated rejection/cache reuse checks, and value-only/fused sampler parity. Verification: reframe4s-resampleJVM 13/13, resampleJS 11/11, flashalignJVM 47/47, flashalignJS 47/47; complete/full tolerance 2e-13; node scripts/verify-symbol-ownership.mjs 1179 public names/64 canonical owners; verify-prd 148 IDs/27 nodes/94 edges/DAG; verify-build-graph 27/94; git diff --check clean. No timing or MRI-accuracy claim.
